title: Week 10 Preview: Habib's Heater Meets the Hulk, Kai Wants His One Point Back, and Randy and Z² Play for Their Lives
dek: A four-game win streak runs into the league's best team, a one-point grudge gets a rematch, and two 3-6 teams meet in a game only one of them survives.
body: The headliner is the hottest team in the league against the best one. Habibsters have won four straight, climbing from 1-4 to 5-4 on scores of 119.84, 120.96 and 133.5, and now they visit No Banner only HULK, the 7-2 juggernaut sitting on 1,203.9 points. History is quietly on Habib's side, with an 8-4 all-time edge in this series, but Brucie flipped the script in Week 3 with a 134.46 to 100.74 beatdown. The quarterback duel is Josh Allen against Dak Prescott, and Dak comes stacked with CeeDee Lamb, which is Kaushal's whole plan in one sentence. Luffy gives Ramon an 87% chance, and while HULK's playoff spot is safe either way, a loss would drop Habib to the wrong side of a coin flip for the postseason. CeeDee Lamb and Kenneth Walker III are on the Bounty Board, and whichever one shows up decides this.

The grudge match of the week is Dawgs hosting The Horse is Hea, a rematch of a Week 3 game Sonny won 122.7 to 121.7. One point. Kai has had six weeks to think about it, and he arrives on a two-game win streak with his trade haul from Randy, Jonathan Taylor and Amon-Ra St. Brown, both in the starting lineup. The positional clash is delicious: a Dawgs backfield of Kyren Williams, James Cook III and Taylor against Sonny's receiver room of Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Parker Washington and Christian Watson. At quarterback it's Jayden Daniels against C.J. Stroud, who scored 35.36 on Sonny's bench last week and is back where he belongs. Ja'Marr Chase and Smith-Njigba are on the board, and keep an eye on Ollie Gordon II, a quiet RB for Sonny who could flip a close one. Luffy likes Mekhi at 66%, and the stakes are real: a win pushes Kai toward the playoff line, a loss leaves him chasing, while a Sonny win nearly locks up his spot.

Then there's the elimination game. The fumblers and Ghostu-Spider SZN are both 3-6, both sliding, and the loser is all but finished, while the winner keeps a faint pulse. Randy has lost six straight, even after finally making a trade, and Tee Higgins, who led The fumblers last week, is the new guy trying to snap it. Zoe has dropped two in a row and lost the Week 3 meeting 91.64 to 86.64, so she has a five-point score to settle. It's Trevor Lawrence against Jared Goff under center, and the Chicago-versus-Wisconsin argument finally gets a scoreboard. Derrick Henry, coming off a Seastoned week, and Tetairoa McMillan are the players who decide it, and Luffy gives Randy a 62% chance to end the skid.

Finally, Team Pillbert hosts Counting or not Counting GV, which looks like a formality on paper. Philly scored 132.38 last week and lost by 1.12, so he arrives with something to prove, and a win all but punches his playoff ticket. JMoney's postseason hopes are gone, which makes him the most dangerous thing in fantasy football: a spoiler with Joe Burrow, who went Gear 5 for him last week, going up against Brock Purdy. Jahmyr Gibbs and Bhayshul Tuten are on the Bounty Board, and Chuba Hubbard gives Alan a sneaky second engine in the backfield. Luffy gives Team Pillbert an 81% chance, but nobody in this league has forgotten what happens when a 2-7 team gets a ride from its quarterback.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Week 10 card. Team Pillbert LOCK. Habibsters LOCK. Dawgs LOCK. Ghostu-Spider SZN LOCK. JMoney's team burned me last week and I will be watching them lose from the front row.

social.author: Gamma Ray Gang
social.text: Sal says Habib's streak is real and HULK is due for a stumble. Sal, we just scored 147.96. Bring the streak. Bring the 8-4. We'll bring Walker.

social.author: Fumble Recovery Unit
social.text: Sal won't touch our six-game losing streak with a ten-foot pole. Fine. Nina and Dana are on board. Henry, please, I am begging you, just get to double digits.

social.author: Pillbert Til I Die
social.text: Marcus Pell is 3-5 and just picked a 2-7 team to beat us because 'nothing to lose.' Marcus, you have berries to lose. ฿91M and dropping.

social.author: Cheesehead Spider
social.text: Randy finally traded and the losing streak STILL wouldn't leave. Seven is a nice number, Randy. Z² is coming.

social.author: Horse Sense
social.text: Three panelists picking Dawgs and Marcus is the only one who remembers we won the last one. One point, Kai. We'll do it again. JSN and Stroud, let's go.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Garrett Wilson is in JMoney's starting lineup again after posting a zero as a non-playing starter in Week 9. Worth a final check for every manager before Thursday kickoff.

social.author: Habibsters
social.text: Four straight. Dak and CeeDee in the same lineup. The league leaders waiting. Matchday starts tonight. #HabibNation

picks.game: Team Pillbert (Alan) vs Counting or not Counting GV (Jordan)

panel.take: Alan has two backs carrying real workloads in Gibbs and Hubbard, plus Javonte Williams. Jordan's lineup is full this week, which helps, but it doesn't close the gap.
Nothing to lose is the most dangerous phrase in sports, and JMoney has nothing to lose. Burrow just went Gear 5 for him, and I'll take the spoiler over the team still licking its 1.12-point wound.
Counting or not Counting GV cost me a LOCK last week and I don't forgive. Philly by thirty, and I'm enjoying every point.
Luffy has Team Pillbert at 81%. If Gibbs hits 30, it's 96%; Jordan's path needs Bhayshul Tuten at 23-plus, and even then it's only 35%.

picks.game: No Banner only HULK (Ramon) vs Habibsters (Kaushal)

panel.take: Ramon has Josh Allen, McCaffrey and Walker all starting, with no holes to fill. That's a very hard week to beat, streak or not.
Habib owns this series 8-4 and has won four straight. History doesn't care about points-for, and neither do I.
Habib paid me last week and I ride with the guys who pay me. HULK is due for a stumble and the streak is REAL. LOCK.
Luffy says 87% HULK. Habib needs CeeDee at 24-plus to get to 31%, and if Walker reaches 33 again, it's 97% and over by halftime.

picks.game: Dawgs (Mekhi) vs The Horse is Hea (Sonny)

panel.take: The Taylor and St. Brown additions give Kai real depth across his lineup. Sonny's receivers are good, but Mekhi's backfield is the deepest unit in this game.
Sonny won the last meeting by one point and leads the series 7-5. Grudges make great stories, but the guy who keeps winning the close ones keeps winning them. Also, watch Ollie Gordon II.
Kai went 4-for-4 for me in my heart and 2-for-2 on the scoreboard. Revenge for the one-point loss. LOCK, and I'm betting big.
Luffy has Dawgs at 66%. Chase at 28-plus pushes it to 84%, and if Smith-Njigba finishes under 9, Sonny falls to 21%. I'm up ฿88M from nothing, so I'm trusting Luffy here.
Higgins led the team last week, and Randy's lineup is more balanced with Warren and Pollard behind Henry. Six straight losses has to end somewhere.
I missed on Zoe last week and I'm going right back to the well. A rookie who's learning fast against a team that has forgotten how to win is my favorite kind of underdog.
I don't touch a six-game losing streak. Never. Z² is a LOCK and Randy can take it up with Derrick Henry.
Luffy says 62% Randy. Henry at 25-plus makes it 82%, but if McMillan reaches 20, Zoe is the favorite at 57%, so this is closer than it looks.
